channel.title: Jay Respawns — Patch Notes (Official Sources Only)
channel.description: Official patch notes from developer and publisher sources. No press outlets. Updated daily.

item.title: Celebrating our community
item.description:
Freedoms Greetings Helldivers, 

Our devs are hard at work on a Hot Fix for the game, more info to be shared on that next week. 

So we wanted to use today's blog to celebrate an amazing initiative from players within our community: “HEROES 2026”, The Freedom Alliance annual fundraiser with Save The Children.

item.title: Apex Legends: Latest Update 7/2/2026 3:15PM PT
item.description:
Hi all, just pushed a couple more fixes.

FIXED:

  • Octane's jump pads will no longer bounce unintended objects (thank you for making the most of this bug with firing range clips, they made us chuckle).

  • Made adjustments to further improve recent FPS fixes.

item.title: 0.5.4b Patch Notes
item.description:
0.5.4b Patch Notes

Boss Improvements

  • Removed a majority of the stun and freeze immunity windows from all versions of the Tor Gul, the Defiler boss fight.

  • Improved the Minion Phase in the Tasgul, Swallower of Light fight.

  • Fixed a bug where It That Was Esh could sometimes fail to advance phases properly.

item.title: Apex Legends: Latest Update 7/2/2026
item.description:
FIXED:

We just pushed a fix that should mitigate lingering FPS issues resulting from hardware-specific issues on some PCs since the beginning of the split. Your gameplay experience should be much smoother now.

item.title: Store Update 10.14.0
item.description:
READY FOR DEPARTURE

Welcome to Season 10’s last update!
Sponsor Showdown is almost over, the Store got refreshed and XP Feast is still live to help you finish these last Battle Pass pages. In the meantime, Season 11 is right around the corner, and we can’t wait to start sharing more very, very soon™

item.title: Beta Patch Notes - v0.108.0
item.description:
For all you beta testers who have been chomping at the bit for a new patch to chew on... here it is! Today's beta patch brings a ton of fixes, balance changes, some UX additions, a BIG batch of new multiplayer cards, and new art additions--including some animations for the latest boss, Aeonglass!



We've also got some big updates in the modding realm to call out...

item.title: COMMON GROUND
item.description:
APARTMENT COMPLEX

The apartment complex is a new monument that allows players getting started with a wipe to find a place to call home. Simply talk to the receptionist in the lobby to get started and rent a room.
